<div class="toolbox-kind">Resource · verification pending</div>

## Known services

| Need | Known endpoint | Intended use |
|---|---|---|
| Geographic levels | `https://sms.bfs.admin.ch/WcfBFSSpecificService.svc/AnonymousRest/communes/levels` | Municipality correspondence with common geographic levels at a date |
| Correspondence between dates | `https://sms.bfs.admin.ch/WcfBFSSpecificService.svc/AnonymousRest/communes/correspondances` | Map municipality states between two dates |
| Municipality mutations | `https://www.agvchapp.bfs.admin.ch/api/communes/mutations` | Retrieve mutation history |

Expected level parameters include `startPeriod`, `endPeriod`, `useBfsCode`, `labelLanguages` and `format`. Their current syntax and response schemas have not yet been verified, so executable requests are intentionally omitted.

Mutation records are history, not automatically a clean correspondence key. Build and validate a key before joining historical observations.

See [municipality harmonization](../recipes/municipality-harmonization.qmd) and the [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md).
